svg.text: K3b DRUM — one tilting, spinning, heated cup does nine jobs
It tilts about its own lower lip, spins on a magnet coupling through a closed wall, and holds passive tools on a post.
cup Ø 260 × 300 tri-ply, 15.9 L · ≈ 22 kg module
tilt +60° … −35° (worm gear 100 Nm) · spin 0–400 rpm (40 Nm)
induction 3.0 kW on the yoke · load cells ±10 g
no seal at the food: spin canned, tilt seal 150 mm behind
Pivot = lower lip: the pour point never moves; gully and spindle S sit under it.
tools stand still; the cup turns past them
SPIN WITHOUT A SEAL: canned magnet bell
outer ring: welded to the drum back,
wall of the dry pod. Nothing
WHAT IT IS MADE OF (drawn at 0° tilt)
spun tri-ply cup Ø 260 × 300, welded helix fin
fan nozzles on the yoke: water, hot water, detergent
tool post Ø 20 on the yoke ring (tilts with the cup)
induction segment 3 kW, 4 mm under the wall
pedestal behind: worm gear 100 Nm, 1 lip seal, load cells
bell with 12-pole magnet ring over the thimble
sealed pod: motor and inner rotor, dry
NINE MODES = tilt + speed + passive tool

g.text: 1/9 Load: mouth up at +60°; the hand tips a box of unwashed potatoes straight in
2/9 Tumble wash at +30°: yoke nozzles add water, the drum turns back and forth, then pours the dirty water over its lip to the gully
3/9 Rumbler: knurled disc keyed to the back, roller hold-back on the post, 120 rpm with spray: skins scrub off, slurry poured to the gully
4/9 Boil in the basket liner: the coil under the wall heats; at −10° the water runs out through the annulus, the potatoes stay
5/9 Mash at +40°: the hand hangs the masher grid on the post; the cup turns slowly past it (80 °C wall)
6/9 Discharge: tilt to −35°, the food pours about the fixed lip into the vessel held under it; the roller scrapes the wall
7/9 Knead at +35°, 80 rpm against the roller-scraper; the magnet lag measures the dough torque
8/9 Spin dry: leaves in the basket at up to 400 rpm, ≤ 0.5 kg so the drum stays quiet
9/9 Self-wash: detergent tumble at all tilts, 1 L heated to 90 °C for 2 min, poured off; the camera checks the mirror finish
